title: Escalate an approval to someone who can give it
description:
**Phase 6 of 7.**

- **Blocked by:** eef4aa and ac3b7a
- **Runs in parallel with:** nothing. Last item in the epic
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
An action exceeding the requester's ceiling routes to the nearest member whose ceiling covers it. docs/APPROVAL.md records that v1 has no completable path while nobody is at a screen, and that presence is guaranteed only for a human in the web tab. In an organization presence is a team property, so human_takeover and immutable_approval can be satisfied by any member with standing.

Revisit whether approval_fatigue can stay in V1_POLICY_EXCLUSIONS once five people share one bot.
